gates.title_zh: 任务目标和验收标准明确
gates.requirement_zh: 有明确任务目标、输入输出与可操作验收条件
gates.action_zh: 为此活动补充任务契约与验收标准
gates.requirement_en: Inputs, outputs, objectives, and executable acceptance checks are explicitly defined.
gates.action_en: Write a task brief with observable acceptance criteria.

gates.title_zh: 所需资料可靠且获授权
gates.requirement_zh: 能够取得必要资料，满足来源、时效与使用授权要求
gates.action_zh: 补齐资料、来源/版本与数据访问授权
gates.requirement_en: Required materials can be accessed with provenance, freshness, and permissions in place.
gates.action_en: Resolve source quality, provenance, and authorized access gaps.

gates.title_zh: AI 工具与操作路径获准
gates.requirement_zh: 工具可合法合规访问，必要系统操作有受控接口/人工交接
gates.action_zh: 解决工具访问、最小权限或受控人工交接
gates.title_en: Approved AI tools and action path
gates.requirement_en: The tool is approved for the activity, with a controlled interface or human handoff for necessary actions.
gates.action_en: Provide authorized tool access, minimum permissions, or an explicit human handoff.

gates.title_zh: 人工与 AI 责任和流程明确
gates.requirement_zh: 有明确输入输出、交接节点、复核人及执行步骤
gates.action_zh: 梳理角色分工和可复现流程
gates.requirement_en: Human and AI responsibilities, review points, and execution steps are defined.
gates.action_en: Document owners, handoffs, and a reproducible execution procedure.

gates.requirement_zh: 有可执行的质量检查与失败判据
gates.action_zh: 建立结果验证规则与代表性测试
gates.requirement_en: Executable quality checks and failure criteria are available.
gates.action_en: Create acceptance checks and representative evaluation cases.

gates.title_zh: 监督、异常处理与恢复具备
gates.requirement_zh: 有权限监督、人工接管、异常升级和恢复路径
gates.action_zh: 落实审批、异常处理和恢复机制
gates.requirement_en: Appropriate permissions, human takeover, escalation, and recovery plans are in place.
gates.action_en: Set up human oversight, incident handling, and rollback or recovery routes.
